text:
Maya R: quick design q — in the console charts, should we prefer `per sec` or `/s` in the axis unit? current layout looks cramped when we show `p95` lines too :frowning_face:
Samir K: I vote for `/s` — shorter, aligns with technical users. but we lose clarity for non-engr folks. maybe tooltip expands it? :thinking_face:
Lucy P: +1 to tooltip expansion. Also we should consider how the legend behaves when we toggle smoothing — right now toggling on smooth hides the raw series but legend still shows both names, which is confusing.
Maya R: true. Proposed: when smoothing is enabled we collapse the raw into a subdued, expandable item in the legend (light gray, `Show raw` link). keeps the context without clutter.
Jared L: sounds good. accessibility note: collapsed legend items must be keyboard-focusable and announce "raw series collapsed" to screen readers.
Samir K: on outliers — product asked for "suppress noise" option. two approaches: cap values (clip at xth percentile) or fade out isolated spikes visually (reduce alpha). which do we want?
Lucy P: fade approach keeps the data intact for hover and query, just deemphasizes. clip changes the underlying visual scale and can mislead. prefer fade.
Maya R: agreed. wording for the control? product suggested "Suppress spikes" which is vague. ideas: `De-emphasize isolated spikes` (long), `Spike fade` (short), `Isolate spike highlight` (bad).
Jared L: microcopy proposal: label: "De-emphasize outliers"; helper text: "Reduce visual prominence of isolated spikes without altering underlying values." short and clear.
Samir K: +1. Also propose a small toggle below smoothing: `De-emphasize outliers (alpha fade)` so users see relation.
DesignBot: A11y reminder: color alone can't convey de-emphasis. Ensure alpha change is accompanied by aria-live region text when the toggle is turned on/off.
Lucy P: good catch — add `aria-hidden` for faded points and provide an alternate textual summary row in the chart caption: "Outlier de-emphasis enabled".
Maya R: copy tweak for units: primary axis shows `/s`, tooltip shows "requests per second (req/s)" and legend compact view shows `req/s`. That should satisfy both crowd types.
Samir K: small CSS/JS suggestion for legend collapse (pseudo):
```
.legend-item.collapsed { color: #9aa0a6; cursor: pointer; }
.legend-item.collapsed button { outline: none; }
```
Make sure focus style remains visible.
Jared L: could you add a keyboard shortcut? `L` to focus legend, then arrow keys to navigate, Enter to expand/collapse.
Maya R: I'll draft the PR with the prop `deEmphasizeOutliers: boolean` and the legend collapse state. planning to include the copy and aria strings.
Samir K: can you also include an opt-in beta flag in Console so we can test with a few teams?
Maya R: yep, will add `console.featureFlags.chartOutlierFade`.
Lucy P: tiny nit on tooltip copy: use sentence case — "Requests per second (req/s)" not "requests per second".
Maya R: noted. I'll post a quick mock in Figma and link it here when ready. :eyes:
DesignBot: PR checklist — add keyboard focus states, aria labels for collapsed legend items, tooltip copy, feature flag.
Maya R: thanks — opening PR shortly (will ping this thread).
